terms.note.de.ausbildung.text: Vocational training under the BBiG: 24 to 42 months, a probation of 1 to 4 months, at least €724 a month in the first year for a start in 2026.
terms.note.de.ausbildung.context: An email from a company’s hiring team to a candidate (or to the team about a candidate). Polite, plain and personal; a candidate may not know the company yet. application/pack-notes.ts: text built in code.

terms.note.de.befristet_mit_sachgrund.text: Fixed term for one of the objective reasons in § 14(1) TzBfG, of any length. Signed in writing before work starts, or it becomes open-ended.
terms.note.de.befristet_mit_sachgrund.context: An email from a company’s hiring team to a candidate (or to the team about a candidate). Polite, plain and personal; a candidate may not know the company yet. application/pack-notes.ts: text built in code.

terms.note.de.befristet_ohne_sachgrund.text: Fixed term without a reason: at most 2 years with up to 3 extensions (4 years in a company’s first 4), and never for someone employed here before.
terms.note.de.befristet_ohne_sachgrund.context: An email from a company’s hiring team to a candidate (or to the team about a candidate). Polite, plain and personal; a candidate may not know the company yet. application/pack-notes.ts: text built in code.

terms.note.de.freier_mitarbeiter.text: A service contract, not employment: no leave, probation or Mindestlohn. Set hours, place and instructions would make it employment (§ 7 SGB IV).
terms.note.de.freier_mitarbeiter.context: An email from a company’s hiring team to a candidate (or to the team about a candidate). Polite, plain and personal; a candidate may not know the company yet. application/pack-notes.ts: text built in code.

terms.note.de.kurzfristig.text: Short-term work: at most 3 months or 70 working days in a calendar year, not the person’s main occupation. No social insurance contributions (§ 8(1) no. 2 SGB IV).
terms.note.de.kurzfristig.context: An email from a company’s hiring team to a candidate (or to the team about a candidate). Polite, plain and personal; a candidate may not know the company yet. application/pack-notes.ts: text built in code.

terms.note.de.minijob.text: Pay up to €603 a month in 2026 (§ 8(1a) SGB IV), with flat-rate employer contributions. Every employee right applies, leave included.
terms.note.de.minijob.context: An email from a company’s hiring team to a candidate (or to the team about a candidate). Polite, plain and personal; a candidate may not know the company yet. application/pack-notes.ts: text built in code.

terms.note.de.praktikum_freiwillig.text: Voluntary internship. The Mindestlohn applies once it runs over 3 months (§ 22(1) no. 3 MiLoG); the terms are set out in writing (§ 2(1a) NachwG).
terms.note.de.praktikum_freiwillig.context: An email from a company’s hiring team to a candidate (or to the team about a candidate). Polite, plain and personal; a candidate may not know the company yet. application/pack-notes.ts: text built in code.

terms.note.de.praktikum_pflicht.text: Required by a study or training regulation. Not paid the Mindestlohn (§ 22(1) no. 1 MiLoG).
terms.note.de.praktikum_pflicht.context: An email from a company’s hiring team to a candidate (or to the team about a candidate). Polite, plain and personal; a candidate may not know the company yet. application/pack-notes.ts: text built in code.

terms.note.de.unbefristet.text: Open-ended, full or part time by the hours you set. After six months in a company of more than ten, the Kündigungsschutzgesetz protects against dismissal.
terms.note.de.unbefristet.context: An email from a company’s hiring team to a candidate (or to the team about a candidate). Polite, plain and personal; a candidate may not know the company yet. application/pack-notes.ts: text built in code.

terms.note.de.werkstudent.text: An enrolled student, up to 20 hours a week in term time. Only pension insurance is due (§ 5(3) SGB VI).
terms.note.de.werkstudent.context: An email from a company’s hiring team to a candidate (or to the team about a candidate). Polite, plain and personal; a candidate may not know the company yet. application/pack-notes.ts: text built in code.
